name: vibeediting
description: Edit your videos by talking to Claude: cut silences and fillers, add word-by-word captions (Hindi, English, Hinglish), titles, zooms, motion graphics and stock B-roll, then export Reels, Shorts and YouTube videos. Everything runs on your computer; footage is never uploaded.

vibe_license_key.title: vibeediting license key
vibe_license_key.description: Your key from the purchase email. It looks like VIBE-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

pexels_api_key.title: Pexels API key (optional)
pexels_api_key.description: Free key from https://www.pexels.com/api/ to search stock videos. Leave empty if you don't need stock footage.

pixabay_api_key.title: Pixabay API key (optional)
pixabay_api_key.description: Free key from https://pixabay.com/api/docs/ to search stock videos. Leave empty if you don't need it.
